identity.rationale: AA documents its scoring variant of Zapier AutomationBench; keep separate from the original full-task metric.

task: Complete business workflows through simulated application APIs.
metric: Mean objective completion percentage, zero credit when a guardrail fails.
protocol: AA v4.3: private 657-task split; single run; 50-turn cap; objective-credit score with guardrail-zeroing; both models at max reasoning (not equal compute).

usefulness.rationale: Dated results show headroom and a spread between current models; this supports workflow comparison, not equal-compute or statistical-significance claims.
